title: Sprint: First-class review and audit closeout gates
acceptanceCriteria: Required review and audit gates are first-class closeout policy, not only acceptance text.
Task, sprint, phase, and milestone closeout require passed gate evidence or a forced reason/comment.
Each coherent implementation slice has a scoped Git checkpoint commit or a documented no-commit reason code.
closedReason: Parent sprint complete: required review and audit gates are implemented as first-class closeout policy, reporting and doctor/gate coverage are in place, and sprint closeout evidence/report are recorded.
